import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.'); from lib import *
d=load_base(); y=labels()

print('rms-norm stats: diag', sq.min(), sq.max(), 'offdiag pct', np.percentile(G[np.triu_indices(len(G),1)],[1,50,99]))
D2=sq[:,None]+sq[None,:]-2*G; med=np.median(D2); print('med',med)
print('rbf', krr_cv(np.exp(-D2/med),y,(0.003,0.01),k=10,seeds=(0,)))
print('exp(G/med*2)', krr_cv(np.exp(2*G/med),y,(0.003,0.01,0.03),k=10,seeds=(0,)))
for a,b in [(2,-1),(1,0),(1,-1),(0.7,-0.5)]:
    print('tanh full',a,b, krr_cv(np.tanh(a*G+b)+1,y,(0.003,0.01,0.03,0.1),k=10,seeds=(0,)))
Zc=Z/np.linalg.norm(Z,axis=1,keepdims=True); Gc=Zc@Zc.T
print('cos-exp', krr_cv(np.exp(Gc),y,(0.003,0.01,0.03),k=10,seeds=(0,)))
